_about: Geography of the two chart images (stage 1c). Both were drawn for the approved Map Lab (ref/map-lab.html) from the same coast data as assets/coast (see assets/coast/SOURCES.md) and extracted here as files. detail.png: the shaded real-coast render at 20 m per pixel (= 2 game metres) round the start area; overview.png: a plain parchment land/sea map of the whole coast at 100 m per pixel. Positions convert with the same lon/lat -> game-metre projection as the coast (coast-data.js toPx).
